profile.address: Via Caldera, Settimo Milanese, Milan, Italy
profile.reading:
Avalon 2 is the smallest of the three buildings that make up the Avalon Campus on the western edge of Milan. The operator locates it in Settimo Milanese, less than 3 kilometres from Avalon 1 in Via Caldera.

The published specification is short but specific. Avalon 2 offers 300 square metres of floor area, 650 kW of IT power, floor loading rated at 1,500 kilograms per square metre, and electricity the operator describes as 100 percent renewable. The 650 kW is stated as IT power, so it is recorded here as IT load and not as a utility service size, and no utility supply figure, generator rating or UPS rating is published for this building. The building's value inside the campus is interconnection rather than scale. It is joined to Avalon 1 over two physically separate fibre optic paths carrying 192 fibres, which the operator says can grow to 720, with transport capacity of up to 400 Gbit/s. A distributed meet-me room architecture extends across all Avalon Campus buildings, so a customer in Avalon 2 can reach the more than 170 operators present in Avalon 1 by cross connect. A network operations centre with staff on duty around the clock monitors the network infrastructure.

Several things are deliberately not claimed here. The operator publishes ANSI/TIA-942 Rating 4, Uptime Institute Tier IV, ISO 22237 and LEED Gold certification for Avalon 3, the newest and largest campus building, and does not extend those certifications to Avalon 2 on its facility page, so this registry does not extend them either. No PUE, cooling design detail, opening date or hall count is published for Avalon 2.

The record also carries a stale operator name. The OpenStreetMap node was created on 12 November 2022 by a mapper whose changeset comment reads simply that a data centre was inserted, with the name Avalon 2, the operator Irideos and a website on the irideos.it domain. The node has never been edited since, so the operator tag still reads Irideos. Irideos ceased to exist as an operating company on 1 August 2024, when Retelit finalised the integration of Irideos and Brennercom into Retelit Digital Services, a transaction Retelit announced itself. The building and its operations did not change hands in any physical sense, both companies already sat under the same ownership, but the correct current operator of Avalon 2 is Retelit, and the Irideos name survives here only in an unrevised map tag and a legacy web address.
